children: Grand Theft Auto is having its cake, while eating competitors' too. GTA VI is the most played videogame on PlayStation over the past seven days, replacing Fortnite at the top spot and knocking Roblox down to No. 3, Davidson analysts say in a research note. "GTA VI share of hours (amongst the top 100 games) is 68.5% in the first four/five days post-release, representing the highest share of engagement across any game we've ever seen in our dataset by far," they write. While the game's launch has likely prompted new players to pick up their controllers, it is also stealing a large amount of engagement from competitors, the analysts say. Davidson sees NBA 2K, Roblox, Fortnite and Minecraft all losing players in the near term. Though, that pressure is likely to subside in the coming weeks, the analysts add. (connor.hart@wsj.com)
